I'm on a spot-price electricity contract. Please schedule these appliance cycles for 2024-05-27 so that my electricity cost is as low as possible, without exceeding my household peak load limit:
- dishwasher (dishwasher_1): ready from 06:15, must finish by 17:15
- washing machine (washing_machine_1): ready from 08:30, must finish by 18:00

results.message: Your appliances are scheduled to run as follows: the dishwasher will start at 06:15 and finish by 07:15, while the washing machine will begin at 14:00 and complete its cycle by 15:00. This schedule keeps your energy costs low and stays well within your household peak load limit. The estimated total cost for this day is minimal, ensuring you save on your electricity bill. Enjoy your day with clean dishes and laundry!
